data.credibility: Management generally delivers on operational efficiency targets like working capital and margins, but missed its FY26 revenue growth target of 15% (delivering 11.8%). Long-term Lakshya 31 targets were dropped from quarterly discussion.

lines.line: Promised group order inflow growth of 10% for FY26; delivered successfully.
Promised 15% revenue growth for FY26; missed with actual 11.8%.
Targeted net working capital ratio at 12%; successfully delivered 4.1%.
Targeted EBITDA margin of 8.3% to 8.5%; outperformed with 12.6%.
Expect group order inflows to grow 10% to 12% in FY27; currently on track.
Expect FY27 revenue growth of 10% to 12%; tracking at 11.4% so far.
Expect PP&M margin stable at 7.8% in FY27; tracking at 11.6% so far.
Expect working capital around 10% in FY27; currently on track.
Targeted order inflow CAGR of 10% to 12% under Lakshya 31; pending.
Targeted revenue CAGR of 12% to 15% under Lakshya 31; pending.

bull: Working-capital days tightened impressively from 28 down to -27 over five years, with Q4 FY26 net working capital hitting 4.1%.
Operating cash flow was robust at 115% of reported profit over five years, showing profits turn reliably into cash.
Strong infrastructure execution drove massive order intake, with the infrastructure segment alone securing ₹1,99,064 crore in FY 2025-26.
bear: EBITDA margins have compressed notably from 17.3% in FY21 down to 12.7% in FY26.
Borrowings of ₹140,300 crore against a net worth of ₹113,029 crore yield a heavily geared debt-to-equity ratio of 1.24.
Management missed its FY26 revenue growth target of 15%, achieving only 11.8%.
